text: Among those educated at the grammar school were Thomas De Quincey, Harrison Ainsworth and Samuel Bamford the Radical.
There is also an adult deaf and dumb institution, containing a news-room, lecture hall, chapel, &c., for the use of deaf mutes.
The style is a mixture of Early English and Decorative, and a large amount of decorative art has been expended on the building.
Manchester University consists of one college-Owens College-in its greatly enlarged form.
Monuments. In Piccadilly are bronze statues of Wellington, Watt, Dalton, Peel and Queen Victoria.
